bio: Malmaison Manchester is a stylish boutique hotel, transformed from an elegant 19th century warehouse, located right across the road from Manchester Piccadilly station, amongst the hustle and bustle of the city centre.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include the Chez Mal beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae. There are also menu options which include a glass of Prosecco or Cuvée Malmaison Brut Champagne.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Sunday from 12.30pm to 4pm and costs £29.50 per person.
